# 大乘稻芉經隨聽疏決

**ID:** T2783
**Volume:** T85
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 古逸部
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T2783

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T2783 in one fascicle is an anonymous sub-commentary or *jué* 決 ("resolution") on [法成](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%88%90)'s *Dàshèng dàogǎn jīng suítīng shū* ([KR6i0405](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0405) / T2782). It survives, like its parent text, only in the Dūnhuáng manuscripts and is preserved in Taishō volume 85 (*Gǔyìbù*). The author is not identified in the manuscript. The dating bracket is uncertain: the *jué* genre indicates a clarification of doctrinal points raised in the lecture-record, suggesting composition by a follower of [法成](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%88%90) at Dūnhuáng during the late Tang or early Five Dynasties period.

**Abstract**

The *jué* 決 genre — "resolution" or "decision" — is a sub-commentarial form addressing specific doctrinal cruces in the parent lecture-record. The *Suítīng shū jué* poses and resolves questions about [法成](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%88%90)'s exposition of the twelve nidānas in [KR6i0405](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0405). Where Chos-grub's commentary follows the sequence of the base sūtra ([KR6i0404](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0404)) line-by-line, the *jué* is selective, treating only the points where the master's exposition required further elaboration.

The text is a witness to the **active commentarial tradition that developed around [法成](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%88%90)'s lectures at Dūnhuáng** in the ninth and tenth centuries. The pairing of base text + lecture-record + *jué* (sūtra → shū → jué) is a three-tier structure characteristic of the systematic Buddhist scholarship Chos-grub introduced. Like its parent, the text never entered the printed canon and was recovered only with the opening of Dūnhuáng cave 17.

Related texts: parent commentary [KR6i0405](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0405) / T2782; base sūtra [KR6i0404](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0404) / T712; alternative *Śālistamba* recensions [KR6i0400](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0400), [KR6i0401](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0401), [KR6i0402](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0402), [KR6i0403](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0403).
